title: Temporary encroachments.
officialText:
Encroachments of temporary nature shall comply with Sections 3202.4.1 and 3202.4.3.
*3202.4.1 Sidewalk cafés. Enclosures for sidewalk cafés, where permitted by the Commissioner of the Department of Consumer
and Worker Protection pursuant to applicable law and constructed in compliance with Section 3111, may be constructed beyond
the street line.
*Section 3202.4.1 was amended by Local Law 80 of 2020. This law has an effective date of August 28, 2020.
